description: Clean starting state of the Review settings -> Review scoring page: one score category ("Score") with its three default rows (0/No, 1/Maybe, 2/Yes), no error banner, and no delete affordance next to any row.

Mid-edit state, not yet saved. The first category now has a fourth score row (number "2", label showing a thumbs-up icon) added via its + button. Below it, a second score category card has been created via 'Add another score category' -- it shows the category-name language selector, its own delete (trash) icon, and the Independent score/Weight/Required/Active fields, but no name has been chosen and no scores of its own have been added yet.

Page reloaded after clicking Save on the state in the previous screenshot. A generic red banner reads "We had trouble saving your input - Please see below for details", shown here at the top of the page directly under the category's language selector -- there is no inline marker on any specific row or field telling the organiser which one is actually the problem.

Still within the same failed-save state as the previous screenshot, scrolled down to the score rows: the fourth row now reads number "2" (its number field was left untouched) and label "12" (freshly typed, cursor visible), yet nothing on or near this row indicates it is the one the generic banner is complaining about.

State after a later Save on the same page, this time with no error banner at all. The category is back down to four rows (0/No, 1/Maybe, 2/Yes, 2/12) and the second, unnamed category from screenshot 2 is gone entirely -- with nothing on the page indicating what was kept, what was discarded, or that anything unusual happened.
